text: 62-year-old male. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of smoking, African origin, and the specific location of these lesions, I am concerned about potential human papillomavirus (HPV) related malignancies. text: The normal immunohistochemistry results for HPV and p53 are unusual for typical squamous cell carcinoma, prompting me to reconsider the diagnosis given the specific clinical presentation of non-healing, crusted lesions on the penis and finger in an immigrant from Africa.
